I’m Jack Rhysider. This is Darknet Diaries. JACK: This is a story about a guy named Alberto Yusi Lajud-Pena. He was born in the Dominican Republic, and when he was a teenager, his family immigrated to the United States, to Yonkers, New York, to be exact, which is about an hour north of New York City. By the way, Washington Heights, a neighborhood in New York City, has so many people from the DR, its nickname is Little DR. For a lot of people, being in the big city fills them up with big ideas.
